question: Bir village of Himachal Pradesh hosted which sporting event for the first time in 2015?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Paragliding World Cup**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Bir village**, located in **Himachal Pradesh, India**, is renowned for its stunning natural beauty and favorable conditions for adventure sports like paragliding.
 
• In **2015**, Bir village hosted the **Paragliding World Cup** for the first time, marking a significant milestone in India's adventure sports scene.
 
• The **Paragliding World Cup** is an international competition where skilled paragliders from different parts of the world participate.
 
• This event was organized by the **Paragliding World Cup Association (PWCA)**, which is responsible for promoting and managing paragliding competitions globally.
 
• Bir village is considered the **paragliding capital of India**, thanks to its favorable geography, including clear skies, ideal wind patterns, and scenic landscapes. *Hence, the statement is correct.*
 
• Hosting the **Paragliding World Cup** helped Bir gain recognition as a premier destination for adventure sports, boosting local tourism and economic growth.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Bir village and its significance:**

 
 
• **Bir village** is located in the **Kangra district** of Himachal Pradesh, India. It is a hub for eco-tourism and adventure sports, especially paragliding.
 
• The village is situated at an altitude of approximately **1,525 meters** above sea level, making it an ideal spot for paragliding enthusiasts.
 
• **Billing**, a nearby location, serves as the take-off site for paragliding, while Bir acts as the landing area.
 
 
 
• **Paragliding World Cup:**
 
 
• The **Paragliding World Cup Association (PWCA)** organizes this event globally to promote paragliding and encourage international participation.
 
• During the **2015 World Cup**, Bir attracted participants from over **30 countries**, showcasing its world-class infrastructure for hosting such events.
 
• The competition featured multiple rounds and challenges, testing the skills, strategy, and endurance of participants.
 
 
 
• **Impact of the event:**
 
 
• The event significantly boosted **local tourism**, attracting thousands of spectators and adventure enthusiasts to Bir.
 
• It also highlighted India's potential as a destination for international adventure sports, paving the way for similar events in the future.
 
• The **Paragliding World Cup** contributed to the economic development of the region by creating opportunities for local businesses and service providers.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Adventure sports in Himachal Pradesh:**

 
 
• **Himachal Pradesh** is a popular destination for adventure sports like trekking, river rafting, skiing, and paragliding.
 
• Bir-Billing is internationally recognized as a **premier paragliding site**, offering world-class facilities and breathtaking landscapes.
 
 
 
• **Global recognition:**
 
 
• Hosting the **Paragliding World Cup** in 2015 helped India gain recognition as a destination for international adventure sports.
 
• The event placed Bir village on the global map, attracting adventure enthusiasts and tourists worldwide.
